security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: A lightweight floating clock and timer
bundle.longDescription: Catime is a tiny, always-available floating clock with countdown, stopwatch and pomodoro modes. Frameless, transparent, customizable, and entirely local.
